answer: In a distributed multi-agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced through computational proof-of-work modulated by memory-hard cryptographic puzzles that act like a digital gale, blowing away transient, low-cost bot identities. To generate a valid registration echo, each node must burn verifiable resources bound to hardware identifiers—symbolically akin to mining ferrous ore from silicon—imposing a strict physical and thermodynamic cost on any adversary attempting to flood the network with fake personas.
